an5.8:1.1: “Bhikkhus, possessing five qualities a bhikkhu falls away and is not established in the good Dhamma.
an5.8:1.3: (1) A bhikkhu devoid of faith falls away and is not established in the good Dhamma.
an5.8:1.7: (5) An unwise bhikkhu falls away and is not established in the good Dhamma.
an5.8:1.8: Possessing these five qualities, a bhikkhu falls away and is not established in the good Dhamma.
an5.8:2.1: “Bhikkhus, possessing five other qualities a bhikkhu does not fall away but is established in the good Dhamma.
an5.8:2.3: (1) A bhikkhu endowed with faith does not fall away but is established in the good Dhamma.
an5.8:2.5: (2) A bhikkhu who has a sense of moral shame … (3) A bhikkhu who has moral dread …
an5.8:2.7: (5) A wise bhikkhu does not fall away but is established in the good Dhamma.
an5.8:2.8: Possessing these five qualities, a bhikkhu does not fall away but is established in the good Dhamma.”
